name: YanGuFang International Group Co. Ltd. Ordinary Shares
summary: YanGuFang International Group Co., Ltd. operates primarily within the People's Republic of China, specializing in the manufacturing and distribution of a wide array of whole grain food products. Its diverse portfolio includes various oat-derived items such as germ groats, rolled oats, oat flour, and oat bran, in addition to gourmet rice. The company also supplies other essential grains like black beans, red beans, and corn. Expanding beyond basic food items, YanGuFang has developed a line of oat-infused health and nutritional products. These offerings feature oat peptide series, dietary fiber powders, oat ß-glucan probiotics, and oat biscuits, alongside flaxseed oil and perilla seed oil products. Furthermore, the company markets oat-based personal care necessities, including toothpaste, facial masks, cleansers, hand soaps, and hand creams. Complementing its product offerings, the group provides technology consulting and related services. YanGuFang distributes its goods through a comprehensive sales strategy that encompasses its dedicated in-house sales force, an established network of distributors, and both traditional retail outlets and online e-commerce platforms. Established in 2020, YanGuFang International Group maintains its corporate headquarters in Shanghai, located in the People's Republic of China.
